items.claim: Jose Montana's wrestling is very poor.
items.quote: The wrestling is god awful for this Brazilian.

items.claim: Jose Montana has a suffocating top game and a nice head and arm choke.
items.quote: His top game suffocating. Literally, he'll suffocate you. He's got a nice head and arm choke.

items.claim: Louis Sutherland has shown some capability to strike and beat Tai Tuivasa in a sloppy fight.
items.quote: Louis Sutherland has shown a little bit of a capability to bang. He was able to beat Taiu to Avasa in a sloppy fight.

items.claim: Louis Sutherland was easily finished by Brando Parisich and Walter Walker.
items.quote: Brando Parisich put him out easy. Walter Walker heel hooked him easy.

items.claim: Bruno Lopez is a decent striker who makes fights exciting and has a heavy low kick.
items.quote: He is a decent striker. He makes it exciting. He's got a heavy low kick

items.claim: Dar Nurgazai is more durable than Bruno Lopez and has good cardio/wrestling advantages to prevent Lopez's jiu-jitsu.
items.quote: I think that durability is a big deal, especially if he could out wrestle Bruno Lopez where Bruno Lopez can't put the jiu-jitsu on him.

items.claim: Stephen Asplund has a nice karate stance, a nice jab, and good strikes when he wants to use them.
items.quote: he's up against a guy who's got a nice karate stance, some of the worst takedown defense in the UFC, but a nice jab, and when he wants to can put good good strikes on people.

items.claim: Stephen Asplund has some of the worst takedown defense.
items.quote: some of the worst takedown defense in the UFC

items.claim: Stephen Asplund previously hurt Vitor Petrino.
items.quote: Steven Aspelund even hurt Vtor Patrino.
